name: degraded_workspace
description: Edge-case failure-mode fixture. 2 people sharing a first name with distinct full names (Bug #19). 2 people with no email (Bug #44 dead-chrome). Decision events with only title / only summary / only notes (Bug #22 fallback chain). 2 commitment_resolved events that are actually supersedes (Bug #24). Unsanctioned event types (Bug #43). show-my-list wrapper + source pair (I12 cascade).

characteristics.unsanctioned_note: Resolved against the LIVE events.schema.json enum at generation time and asserted illegal. The 0.1-skeleton spec named followup_pack_drafted here, but it was added to the schema by 4.8.0 -- it is legal now and would have silently stopped testing Bug #43 detection. The generator fails loudly if fewer than 2 candidates remain illegal.
characteristics.first_name_collision_note: The 0.1-skeleton spec named 'Daniel Pourbaba' and 'Daniel Walker'. Neither is in cr1's approved placeholder allowlist and 'Pourbaba' reads as a real surname, so it was replaced with approved placeholders. Flagged to M.

fail_intentional_note: I10 (schema_compliance) should FAIL because the fixture deliberately contains unsanctioned event types -- this verifies the invariant detection works.
